question: How can every Module consumer reuse the exact positioned source interpretation produced by lowering while preserving source channel, complete grammar, entry, availability generation, namespace and Registry ownership, and how must refusal propagate?
conclusion: RetainedSourceModuleBindings keeps one immutable Arc-backed positioned SourceCommandBindings inventory. Its checked projection joins the actual Module source/channel, complete grammar, entry/input, namespace and Registry snapshot to that original producer. document_realm_bindings_for_module shares the derived inventory and complete metadata input without fresh analysis. Refusal makes callers opaque, withdraws interprocedural summaries, withholds conditional warnings and stops rewrites before writes. Actual new cross-file or synthetic source enters its own explicit lowering path. Mutable derived inventory detaches through the central copy-on-write owner. The original missing-command source owner joins exact current table absence to typed mutation history under this same Module. Logical static head geometry uses the shared source naming purpose and original operand lookup closure; Native diagnostics separately require genuine generic compilation and reached original keys. An absent table cell creates no descriptor, unknown-handler target, Native compiler, frame or execution receipt.
scope: Current Rust source ownership contract and nine genuine direct software test definitions. Their actual module parents, complete bodies and source hashes are inspected; no own executable inventory or assertion outcome is attached. The six-profile software recipe loop is not an external C/Jim comparison. An immutable earlier source owner supplies no correspondence for changed Module bytes, channel, configuration, availability or entry. None from the checked projection is terminal refusal; CommandBindingRealm::none/default and optional helper assistance cannot substitute. Existing Native lookup/evaluation, frame, completion, physical object/store, implementation identity and rewrite guards remain independent. No timing improvement, completed performance comparison, source-to-library equivalence or BIG-IP result is claimed.
